text:
samir: Customer reported sudden SSO failures after IdP cert rotation. Our logs show "Recipient URL mismatch" on assertion verification.
lin: Which org? Any sample SAMLResponse (redact PII) or SP logs we can look at?
samir: Org: acme-finance-prod. They sent a base64 SAMLResponse (redacted). Proxy access logs show the ACS POST hitting https://redwood.example.com/_proxy/acme/acs — but their SP metadata lists https://app.acme.com/saml/acs
julia: That suggests the proxy is rewriting the request URL. Did we deploy any path/host rewrite last night? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: We rolled a small nginx rewrite to remove an internal /_proxy prefix for backend routing. It should not touch Host header. Can you paste the Recipient/Audience from the decoded assertion?
samir: Decoded assertion (sanitized):
```
<Assertion>
  <Subject>
    <NameID>user@example.com</NameID>
  </Subject>
  <Conditions>
    <AudienceRestriction>
      <Audience>https://app.acme.com/</Audience>
    </AudienceRestriction>
  </Conditions>
  <AuthnStatement/>
  <AssertionRecipient>https://redwood.example.com/_proxy/acme/acs</AssertionRecipient>
</Assertion>
```
lin: The Recipient in the assertion is the proxied URL — not the public ACS in their SP metadata. Two likely causes: (1) IdP is echoing the request URL (the proxied callback) into Recipient; or (2) the IdP metadata/config was temporarily updated to the proxied endpoint during the cert rotation.
mike: Also double-check our metadata fetch logs around the cert rotation time. If they pushed new metadata with an internal ACS or multiple ACS endpoints, that could explain it. Signature validation could also fail if certs are out of sync.
samir: Support logs show metadata fetched at 2815008000 with new cert and ACS = https://app.acme-internal.local/saml/acs. Then at 2815009000 we received an assertion with Recipient=https://redwood.example.com/_proxy/acme/acs.
julia: That looks like either the customer's IdP is multi-homed or an internal proxy rewrote the SAMLRequest/Response. For mitigation: ask the customer to set their IdP SP configuration to the public ACS (https://app.acme.com/saml/acs) and ensure no rewrite happens during cert rotations. As a short-term fix we could implement an org-scoped fallback to match by path (/saml/acs) rather than full host. Need security approval.
ops-oncall: I prefer not to broaden checks globally. We can add an org-level fallback flag that accepts proxied hostnames with the same path for 48h while they fix it. Should be toggled with audit logs.
julia: I'll open a quick PR (infra/allow-proxied-recipient-fallback) with a 48h TTL and audit hook, tag @security. Can someone draft wording for the audit event?
security: Audit event should include org id, source IPs, original recipient, matched fallback rule id, TTL expiration timestamp, and operator. Approve emergency fallback for 48h with audit. Note: include this incident in the postmortem.
samir: Passed suggested remediation to customer: 1) revert any automated jobs that rewrite ACS during cert rotation, 2) confirm SP metadata publishes public ACS, 3) re-run a login to validate. Provided repro steps.
lin: Once they confirm, request their (redacted) SAMLResponse and we will replay in staging to validate signature/audience. Also capture sp-inbound logs for signature verification traces.
mike: One more item — if IdP rotated signing keys, they might have multiple keys in metadata. Verify that the Assertion is signed by a key present in current metadata. Mismatched keys will manifest as signature failures even if Recipient matches.
samir: Customer replied: they found an internal automation that rewrote ACS to an internal hostname during their cert rotate job. They disabled it and re-tested. Login now succeeds.
ops-oncall: Good to hear. Standby for enabling fallback if they regress.
julia: PR created: infra/allow-proxied-recipient-fallback (#1345). Implementation details: org-scoped flag, path-suffix match, 48h TTL, audit log entry. Tagging security for approval.
security: Approved emergency fallback with 48h TTL and audit entries. Please ensure we expire the flag automatically and record the operator.
samir: Thanks team. I'll write a short incident note for support KB with timeline, repro steps, and recommended idp config. Closing once PR merged and audit confirms. :thumbsup:
